cards.work: The Art of Fugue, BWV 1080: Canon alla Ottava
cards.creator: Johann Sebastian Bach
cards.location: Upper voice mm. 1–2; lower voice mm. 5–6
cards.aliases: バッハ 対位法 オクターブ Bach
cards.finding: The lower voice restates the upper voice’s opening two bars one octave lower.
cards.scope_note_ja: Only the opening subject and its first lower-voice entry were compared.
cards.source_credit: Johann Sebastian Bach; source Breitkopf & Härtel, 1885; typesetting Arnaud Gossart, Mutopia Project.

cards.work: The Art of Fugue, BWV 1080: Canon per Augmentationem in Contrario Motu
cards.creator: Johann Sebastian Bach
cards.location: Upper voice mm. 1–4; lower voice mm. 5–12
cards.aliases: バッハ 対位法 バッハ Bach 拡大 反行
cards.finding: The answering voice doubles the durations and reverses the melodic direction.
cards.scope_note_ja: This does not mean every interval is a strict chromatic inversion.
cards.source_credit: Johann Sebastian Bach; source Breitkopf & Härtel, 1885; typesetting Arnaud Gossart, Mutopia Project.

cards.work: Album für die Jugend, Op. 68 No. 11: Sicilienne
cards.creator: Robert Schumann
cards.aliases: 変拍子 シューマン シチリアーナ 拍子 Sicilienne
cards.finding: The selected passage uses 2/4 and changes back to 6/8 at bar 38.
cards.scope_note_ja: The advance time-signature indication is not counted as the first bar in 2/4.
cards.source_credit: Robert Schumann; Peters source; typesetting Philippe Hézaine © 2007, Mutopia Project. The linked edition is marked CC BY-SA 2.5.

cards.creator: Scott Joplin
cards.location: Mutopia bars 5–6 (Heazlewood-Dale fig. 17 uses A-strain bars 1–2).
cards.aliases: ジョプリン ソレイス ハバネラ Habanera
cards.finding: Across the two bars, each bar’s left-hand attack gaps follow 3:1:2:2.
cards.scope_note_ja: This is the left-hand onset pattern in those bars only. The analytical figure is a separate reference; the two source editions are not treated as interchangeable.
cards.source_credit: Scott Joplin; typesetting Magnus Lewis-Smith, Mutopia Project. Analysis reference: Heazlewood-Dale, Fig. 17 (see DOI).

cards.work: Impromptu in E-flat major, D.899 No. 2
cards.creator: Franz Schubert
cards.aliases: シューベルト 即興曲 和声 五度下降 D899
cards.finding: The bass anchors and chord tones support a descending-fifth reduction in minor.
cards.scope_note_ja: The progression is a harmonic reduction of the passage, not a claim that the score presents block chords.
cards.source_credit: Franz Schubert; source Breitkopf & Härtel, 1888; typesetting Ph. Raynaud, Mutopia Project. Analysis reference: Andre Mount, Fundamentals, Function, and Form, Ex. 25–7.

cards.work: 平均律クラヴィーア曲集 第1巻 ハ長調前奏曲 BWV 846
cards.creator: Johann Sebastian Bach
cards.aliases: バッハ ペダルポイント 保続音 低音 平均律 BWV846
cards.finding: The lowest C is attacked five times while the harmonies above it change. The first half of bar 34 contains the notes of G7 above the pedal.
cards.scope_note_ja: It is not a four-bar tie. The final printed arpeggio and fermata are not represented as separate timings in the MIDI.
cards.source_credit: Johann Sebastian Bach; typesetting Tobias Erbsland, Mutopia Project; source edition unspecified on the catalogue page.

cards.work: Piano Sonata in C minor, Op. 13 (Pathétique), III
cards.creator: Ludwig van Beethoven
cards.edition: Mutopia-2013/01/08-296（Chris Sawer、Berners 1908 / A. Winterberger版に基づく）
cards.location: 第3楽章、PDF p.1、第13小節後半から第14小節頭
cards.aliases: 偽終止 cadence ベートーヴェン 悲愴 第3楽章 G7 A-flat
cards.finding: In C minor, the dominant seventh on G moves to an A-flat major triad at the next barline rather than resolving to the tonic.
cards.scope_note_ja: Applies to this barline and edition only; the MIDI is generated from the engraving.
cards.source_credit: Ludwig van Beethoven; Berners 1908 source edited by A. Winterberger; typesetting Chris Sawer, Mutopia Project.

cards.concept_ja: 反復8分音符の和音伴奏
cards.creator: Robert Schumann
cards.edition: Mutopia-2013/09/01-309（Alexandre Benéteau、Breitkopf & Härtel 1882年版に基づく）
cards.location: PDF p.1、冒頭第1〜4小節、ピアノ右手
cards.aliases: repeated_eighth_chord_accompaniment シューマン 詩人の恋 Dichterliebe Ich grolle nicht 8分 反復
cards.finding: The right hand makes 32 chord attacks on the eighth-note grid across four bars, while the chord pitches change.
cards.scope_note_ja: Only the right-hand part in bars 1–4 was compared. The passage does not repeat a single unchanging chord.
cards.source_credit: Robert Schumann; text Heinrich Heine; Breitkopf & Härtel 1882 source; typesetting Alexandre Benéteau, Mutopia Project.
